Vendored OCR engine for the scan lab. Nothing here is loaded from a CDN:
lab/js/ocr.js passes these paths to Tesseract.js.

tesseract.js 7.0.0 (npm, Apache-2.0, LICENSE-tesseract.js.md)
  tesseract.esm.min.js   from tesseract.js/dist (sourceMappingURL comment removed)
  worker.min.js          from tesseract.js/dist (sourceMappingURL comment removed)
  *.LICENSE.txt          bundled third-party notices from tesseract.js/dist

tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (npm, Apache-2.0, core/LICENSE)
  core/tesseract-core-relaxedsimd-lstm.wasm.js
  core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js
  core/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js
  LSTM-only builds with the WebAssembly embedded. Tesseract.js picks one by
  the browser's SIMD support; a phone downloads one of the three.

eng.traineddata, tessdata_best integerized ("best_int"), Tesseract 4.0.0 model
  lang/eng.traineddata.gz  from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (npm),
                           4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz
  The model itself is from tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best (Apache-2.0,
  lang/LICENSE). Chosen over tessdata_fast on the lab benchmark: see
  lab/README.md.
